display.title: Bottle Stock

lines: Good. The shelf can remain thoughtfully empty a little longer.
Put Bottle Stock aside for now?

abandoned: I will clear the bottle note. Return if the shelf still needs stocking.

abandoned_forever: Then the bottle request is closed for good.
unavailable: There is no bottle request here for me to shelve.

lines: Then keep the glass intact until you are ready.
Bottle Stock is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Bottle Stock is complete. The village can use this, and you have earned the reward.

lines: Then I will keep rinsing old glass and pretending that counts as strategy.
We are down to rinsing old bottles and hoping memory counts as sanitation.
Fresh glass would improve both medicine and morale.

inactive: The shelf has no active bottle count at the moment.

lines: If you have the bottles, we can settle Bottle Stock.
Keep the glass safe until the shelf can take it.
